Realization Mode

  • CURIE: gmeow:RealizationMode
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RealizationMode
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works

The mode in which a musical Expression realizes its Work — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). The oral-tradition guarantee requires that no shape ever mandate a notated realization.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:RealizationMode as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
